causal_interpretation: Under the stated identification assumptions, the IPW estimate represents the estimated average treatment effect of training assignment on the probability of retention or promotion within 180 days.
limitations: This estimate relies on conditional exchangeability given the approved pre-treatment covariates.
Observed covariate balance does not prove absence of unmeasured confounding.
The confidence interval is a nonparametric bootstrap percentile interval.
The propensity model is refit within each bootstrap replicate.
Synthetic ground-truth treatment-effect fields were not used to calculate this estimate or its uncertainty.
